description: This Dart source file defines the WordRepository class, responsible for loading target and valid word lists from assets or fallbacks for a word-guessing game. It includes methods to asynchronously fetch word lists and handle missing assets gracefully.

classes.name: WordRepository
classes.description: A class that loads and provides lists of target and valid words for the game, with embedded fallback lists for resilience.

methods.name: _loadWordList
methods.description: Private static method that reads a text asset file and returns a list of uppercase 5-letter words, or an empty list if loading fails.

methods.name: loadTargetWords
methods.description: Public static method that returns a list of target words, falling back to embedded list if asset loading fails.

methods.name: loadValidWords
methods.description: Public static method that returns a list of valid guess words, falling back to embedded list if asset loading fails.
